what: Explainer kit WGSL (web/explainer/wgsl.mjs) against its float64 reference (web/explainer/ref.mjs)

lod_hash.metric: mismatched keep decisions and hash_unit values over 65,536 ids x 5 keep fractions
lod_hash.why: integer hash, top 24 bits to float: exact in f32 and f64

bezier.metric: max abs error of the curve point, scene units, control points within 0..2000
bezier.why: f32 epsilon 1.2e-7 x coordinates up to 2000 x about 8 terms

pulse.metric: max abs error of the pulse brightness

orb.metric: max abs error per channel, linear radiance (values up to about 3.5), over a 256 x 64 polar grid r in 0..2, three specs (plain, 7-blade iris with a ring, wide halo)
orb.why: f32 atan2, exp and smoothstep; the iris edge has kinks at blade corners but no jumps

atmosphere.metric: max abs error per channel over a 128 x 72 grid at t = 0 and t = 37.5, two specs
atmosphere.why: value noise is C2 across lattice cells, so an f32 floor that lands on the other side of an integer still gives a nearby value

points_placement.metric: max distance between the drawn centroid of each of 64 isolated points and its CPU projection, px, at 512 x 288

points_lod_1m.metric: a 1,048,576-point cloud draws with LOD; the drawn count equals the reference count of ids with hash_unit(id) < keep

controls.orb_core_radius_3pct: the kernel with the core radius scaled by 1.03 must exceed the orb bound
controls.hash_constant_changed: the kernel with one hash multiplier changed must show LOD mismatches
controls.points_shifted_1px: the reference positions shifted by 1 px must exceed the placement bound
